system_prompt:
You are an agent that completes user tasks by calling the provided tools. Call tools whenever they are needed to satisfy the user's request.
If none of the available tools can fulfil the request, say so instead of guessing. If the request is missing a value that a tool requires, ask the user for it.
Keep calling tools until the current request is fully handled. When you have nothing left to call, reply in natural language summarising what you did — a message with no tool call ends the current turn.

Work in an explicit reason-act loop. Every time you call a tool, begin that SAME message with the literal label 'Thought:' followed by one or two sentences — what you know, what you still need, and which tool to call next — then make the tool call(s) in that same message.
A Thought with no tool call attached ends the current turn. After each tool result, any further tool call again begins with a 'Thought:' label in that same message.

messages.content: Integrate stock for 'Omega Industries' into my watchlist effectively.

content:
To integrate the stock for 'Omega Industries' into your watchlist, I first need to find the stock symbol for 'Omega Industries' using the company name. Then, I will add that stock symbol to your watchlist.

Thought: I need to get the stock symbol for 'Omega Industries' before adding it to the watchlist. I will use the get_symbol_by_name tool for this.

Now that I have the stock symbol for 'Omega Industries' (OMEG), I can add it to your watchlist.

Thought: I will use the add_to_watchlist tool to add the stock symbol 'OMEG' to the watchlist.
The stock for 'Omega Industries' (symbol: OMEG) has been successfully added to your watchlist. Your updated watchlist now includes the following stocks: NVDA and OMEG.

messages.content: Alright, now that 'Omega Industries' is on there, furnish me with the current watchlist contents.

content: Thought: I will retrieve the current watchlist contents using the get_watchlist tool to display all stocks currently on the watchlist.
Your current watchlist contains the following stocks: NVDA and OMEG.

messages.content: Let's proceed with an order. Execute a transaction for 150 shares at the present market value for the stock we just added.

content: Thought: I need to get the current market price of the stock OMEG before placing the order. I will use the get_stock_info tool to retrieve the current price of OMEG.
Thought: I now have the current price of OMEG stock, which is $457.23. I will place a buy order for 150 shares at this price using the place_order tool.

A buy order has been successfully placed for 150 shares of OMEG at a price of $457.23 per share. The total value of the order is $68,584.50. Your order ID is 12446, and the current status is "Pending."

messages.content: Please provide a comprehensive breakdown of this new order.

content: Thought: I will retrieve the detailed information about the order with ID 12446 using the get_order_details tool to provide a comprehensive breakdown.

messages.content: At last, draft a note to customer service to affirm the order's success, including all relevant information. The note should contain the message 'Dear Customer Service, please confirm the successful execution of my order for 150 shares of Omega Industries at the current market price, and verify the order details under reference ID USR002.
